name: Baalveer
description: Darkness is on the horizon as Baalveer faces his toughest enemies yet - one who has ended Baalveers across all the universes, and one within himself. Can he overcome the threat and save himself?

videos.title: Montu Harasses Manav And Meher
videos.overview: Baalveer is blessed with the power of fairies and fights evil on earth saving the innocents. Manav and Meher who are always bullied by Montu are running away from him when a dog accidentally saves them. Disturbed by this, their grandmother tells them a story of PariLok.

videos.title: The Pari's Share A Horrific Incident With Rani Pari
videos.overview: Baal Veer is taken to a fairyland where he is blessed with special powers by six fairies, each having her own unique traits. He uses these powers to help his friends, including Manav and Meher.

videos.title: Bhayanak Pari Decides To Conquer Pari Lok
videos.overview: Fairies are frightened by seeing Bhayankar Pari who is in search of Baalveer. Baal Pari inquires about the motive of Bhayankar Pari and why she was looking for her son Baalveer. Rani Pari answers all her questions.

videos.title: An Unforgettable Fight
videos.overview: Rani Pari tells Baal Pari all about Baalveer's past and Baal Pari remembers how she saved Baalveer from the accident and was allowed by all the fairies and Rani Pari to keep the child. That is how he got his name 'Baalveer'.

videos.title: Rani Pari To Give Super Powers To Baalveer
videos.overview: Rani Pari decides that it is time Baalveer goes on earth to help innocent people. Baalveer is super excited hearing this, but his mother Baal Pari is terrified because owing to the dangers on earth. Meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Tauba informs Bhayank Pari that something big is going to happen in Pari Lok.

videos.title: Baalveer Gets Superpowers From All The Paris
videos.overview: Baalveer is given the powers of all the seven fairies to prepare him for Prithvi Lok and fight the evil there. There is a celebration going on in Pari Lok, but meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Tabua Tauba tries to figure out the big thing happening in Pari Lok.

videos.title: Rani Pari Sends Baalveer On A Mission
videos.overview: It is time for Baalveer to finally leave for Prithvi Lok, Rani Pari explains the reason for Baalveer to be on earth to Baal Pari. Baal Pari is sad knowing that soon she will not have Baalveer alongside her, she already misses him and revisits old memories.

videos.title: Bapuji's Illness
videos.overview: Baalveer finally starts his journey for Prithvi Lok. Rani Pari tells him that he has to take care of the "Sath Saccho ka Parivar" and explains to him his mission. Baalveer gets his first sign about here to start on earth. He seeks Natkhat Pari's help adjusting to Prithvi Lok. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari comes to know the whereabouts of Baalveer.

videos.title: Baalveer Fights Against Evil Powers
videos.overview: Baalveer starts his work on the tea stall and also his mission to help kids who are controlled by Bhayankar Pari, his first attempt goes successful but Tauba Tauba warns Bhayankar Pari. Meanwhile, Baalveer fails to deliver the tea order properly and his boss is not happy with it, but Baalveer finds a very generous and good-hearted man to his rescue.

videos.title: Manav And Meher Are Introduced To Baalveer
videos.overview: Mahesh takes Baalveer home with him. Whereas in Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari turns Tauba Tauba into Dooba Dooba 1 and sends him on a mission to Pari Lok to get information on Baalveer. In Dagli's house, everyone welcomes Ballu (Baalveer) except for Manav and Meher, they have a huge problem of their own. Baalveer makes a promise to Manav & Meher.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba Gets Caught In Pari Lok
videos.overview: Tauba gets caught in the Pari Lok, but somehow he manages to escape but not with much information on Baalveer. On the other side in Prithvi Lok, Manav and Meher don't like the attention Ballu is getting and leaves for school. Ballu denies helping Manav and Meher when he sees Montu bullying them. Will Balveer come to their rescue?

videos.title: Montu Gets Electrocuted
videos.overview: Baalveer comes to rescue Manav and Meher. With the help of fairies, he teaches Montu and his friends a lesson that they will never forget. In Bhayank Lok Tauba finds something on Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari reaches one step closer to finding him. Will this lead to Bhayankar Pari and Baalveer coming face to face?

videos.title: Manav And Meher Are Punished
videos.overview: When Montu's father (one of the school's trustees) complains about Manav & Meher bullying Montu with the help of Baalveer, the principle has to punish them. But Baalveer comes on time to help. Bhayankar Pari is still in Prithvi Lok in search of Baalveer but in Pari Lok, Rani Pari has an intuition about something bad.

videos.title: Tea Owner Spills The Beans To Bhayankar Pari
videos.overview: Dari & Bhari Pari are sent to make sure that Bhayankar Pari does not find Baalveer. Bhayankar Pari interrogates chacha about Baalveer. In the school, Baalveer again warns Montu and asks him to leave Manav and Meher alone. Will Montu learn his lesson and apologize to Manav & Meher? Will Bhayankar Pari find Baalveer?

videos.title: Rocky Lands In Deep Trouble
videos.overview: Tauba finds a crucial object which will help him find Baalveer. In Pari Lok Baal Pari gets worried about Baalveer, but Rani Pari assures her about Baalveer's safety. In Dangli house the kids narrate what Baalveer did for them. Will Rani Pari be able to protect Baalveer or will Bhayankar Pari catch him?

videos.title: A Lottery
videos.overview: Baalveer saves a member of Dangli House and Dada Ji tries to get Ballu into Manav and Meher's school. In Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari has laid a trap for Baalveer and visits Pari Lok. Watch this episode to find out Bhayankar Pari's evil plan.

videos.title: Principal And Teachers Are Impressed With Baalveer
videos.overview: Ballu asks Meher to teach him for his admission test, but Meher tries to avoid it. Finally, he seeks the help of Natkhat Pari in studying. In Pari Lok, Rani Pari reveals the secret of Baalveer's safety. Meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari is waiting for Baalveer to take his next move. Will Ballu pass the admission test? Will Baalveer fall into Bhayankar Pari's trap? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Succeeds In Finding Baalveer
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari finally finds Baalveer but is unable to kidnap him because he is protected by Rani Pari's shield. In Pari Lok, Naraz and Taraz Pari request Rani Pani to give them their power back, but Rani Pari disagrees. Will Baalveer be safe? Will Rani Pari know about what Naraz and Taraz did?

videos.title: Montu Becomes A Honeybee
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari sends Nara and Taraz Pari as her informant to Pari Lok in exchange of protection from Rani Pari. Meanwhile, Montu is scared after what he dreamt. Tauba Tauba comes with new information on what kids like and reveals them to Bhayankar Pari. Will the kids become friends? What will Bhayankar Pari do with this new knowledge?

videos.title: Meher Demands An Unique Gift
videos.overview: Meher asks her father for a mobile phone on her birthday, but he refuses. Meher requests Baalveer to convince her father, but he also refuses, but Baalveer with the help of Natkhat Pari gets her a gift. The Dangli's decide that they will celebrate Ballu's birthday on the same day as Meher's. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari is coming up with her new plan.

videos.title: Meher Is Mesmerized
videos.overview: On the morning of Meher's birthday she gets a gift from Baalveer and likes it, but still demands a mobile phone from him. Baalveer accidentally reveals his secret in front of the whole family. And Bhayankar Pari has found her way to Baalveer's school.

videos.title: Manav's Dadaji Lands In Deep Trouble
videos.overview: Dagli house is busy in the preparations of Meher and Ballu's birthday later, Dadaji lands himself in trouble, but Baalveer saves him. On the other side, Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba organize an event in the school and are distributing their Mobile phones. Meher wins the competition and is very happy to finally have gotten a mobile. Will this evil mobile bring trouble for Baalveer?

videos.title: Preparation Of Giant Cake In Pari Lok
videos.overview: All the fairies are preparing to celebrate Baalver's birthday in Pari Lok for the first time, Baalveer is happy to join them and help. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari starts her evil plan of capturing kids through a phone call and keeping them in Bhayank Lok. Her next target is Meher. Will Meher pick up her phone from an unknown caller?

videos.title: Kesari Accepts Balwaan's Challenge
videos.overview: Mahesh's family is super excited to celebrate Meher's and Ballu's birthday. Montu and his friends make fun of the cake made by Meher's mother, seeing this Ballu comes as Baalveer and teaches them a nice lesson in front of everyone. Celebrations are going on in Pari Lok also, but in Bhayanak Lok, Bhayankar Pari captures more kids.

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Kidnaps Meher
videos.overview: Baalveer goes to Pari Lok to celebrate his birthday, everyone is very happy. Meher gets a call from Tauba Tauba on her mobile, despite Baalveer's attempts Meher picks up the phone and is trapped in Bhayanak Lok. She is scared and helpless. Can Baalveer save her? Will Meher tell Bhayankar Pari about Baalveer?

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Tortures Meher
videos.overview: News breaks out that kids are disappearing. Meher's family is in shock. Manav figures out something about disappearing kids. In Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari persuades Meher to call Baalveer to Bhayanak Lok. Will Meher call Baalveer to Bhayanak Lok? How will Baalveer save all of them and Meher?

videos.title: Baalveer Enters Bhayankar Lok
videos.overview: Meher's family is really worried about her, meanwhile, Baal Pari gets the news that Baalveer has gone somewhere and she also gets worried. Baalveer visits Bhayanak Lok to save Meher and other kids and comes across Tauba Tauba and Bhayankar Pari. Watch this episode to find out, what will happen when Bhayankar Pari and Baalveer come face to face?

videos.title: Baalveer Is Trapped In Bhayanak Lok
videos.overview: Baalveer fights Bhayankar Pari. Everyone in Pari Lok comes to know that Baalveer is missing with other kids. Baal Pari is praying that Baalveer is safe and misses him. Bhayankar Pari makes Baalveer her captive. How will Baalveer free himself? Or will Rani Pari come to save everyone? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Reveals The Secret Of Pari Tara
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher are stuck in Bhayankar Pari's cage, Baalveer is waiting for Rani Pari to come and save them. Tauba Tabua gives both of them a hard time. On Prithvi Lok, Montu's friends play a prank on him which gives him an idea to get rid of Baalveer.

videos.title: Honeybees Teach A Lesson To Tauba Tauba
videos.overview: Baalveer fights Tauba Tauba's plan in his special way and helps Meher to not worry a lot. With his magical powers, Baalveer tries to send a message to Pari Lok. In Dagli house police have come to investigate what happened to the kids.

videos.title: Montu Steals Meher's Evil Cell Phone
videos.overview: Naraz Pari contacts Bhayankar Pari to inform her that in the absence of Rani Pari all the fairies are planning to attack Bhayanak Lok and save Baalveer and kids. In Prithvi Lok, Montu and his friends visit Meher's house to execute their plan of getting rid of Baalveer.

videos.title: Baalveer And Meher's Escape
videos.overview: All the fairies come to Bhayanak Lok to rescue Baalveer and all the kids, but this might be a trap laid by Bhayankar Pari. Meanwhile, Baalveer tricks Tauba Tauba to come out of the cage. Who wins in this face-off between fairies from Pari Lok and Bhayankar Pari? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Dooba Dooba Ek Raises Doubt On Naraz Pari
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher are running towards Pari Lok after escaping from the cage, but Bhayankar Pari already has another trap ready for them. In Pari Lok, the injured fairies recover from their injuries. In Dagli House, Manav writes a letter for Rani Pari and Mahesh is considering quitting his job.

videos.title: Dooba Dooba Ek And Natkhat Pari Transform
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher run into Bhayanak Pari's trap. Manav's letter reaches Pari Lok and the fairies decide to help Dagli family. In Prithvi Lok, Montu comes to Manav with another plan to destroy the mobile phone. But will any of this effort bring Baalveer and Meher back?

videos.title: Meher Surprised At A Giant Mango
videos.overview: Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba go to Dagli House disguised as Baalveer and Meher, everyone is happy seeing both the kids. Baalveer and Meher who are in Pari Lok are still unknowingly following Bhayankar Pari's plan of getting the Pari Tara.

videos.title: Taraz Pari Shocked To See Baalveer
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher continue on their path to get Pari Tara avoiding everyone in Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba are trying their best in Prithvi Lok to avoid their cover being blown. Things get interesting when some reporters come to Dagli House.

videos.title: Baalveer's Interview
videos.overview: The media wants to hear from Baalveer and Meher who entered the mobile phone. Manav notices that Ballu is behaving differently which creates a doubt in his mind. In Pari Lok, Baalveer tries to enter the Rani Mahal to retrieve Pari Tara. Will he be successful in doing so without getting caught?

videos.title: Baalveer Solves A Mysterious Puzzle
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher need to figure out where Rani Pari has kept the Pari Tara. They stumble upon a box, that contains the keys to reach Pari Tara, but they need to find the lock before sunrise. Can they do it on time? Or are they getting themselves into more trouble?

videos.title: Baalveer Reveals His Plan To Chulbuli Titli
videos.overview: Baalveer moves a step closer to finding the Pari Tara, but his race is against time, and he has only one attempt to achieve it. In Prithvi Lok, Montu and his friends try to find out about the whereabouts of Baalveer, but Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba try to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Baalveer And Meher Fall In A Pit
videos.overview: The quest for Pari Tara is proving to be never-ending for Baalveer. He comes across another puzzle to reach to it and it's only getting more difficult. On earth, Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba disguised as Baalveer and Meher prank Montu and his friends to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Baalveer's Master Plan
videos.overview: Baalveer and Meher are close to Pari Tara, but this new obstacle is tricky and can probably be their end for this quest if they are not careful. On the other side, Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba find it difficult to hide their identity from everyone. Rani Pari finally comes out of her annual meditation.

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Surprised To See Pari Tara
videos.overview: All the fairies gather in Pari Mahal and tell Rani Pari about everything that happened while she was gone. Rani Pari realizes Bhayankar Pari's real motive behind trapping Baalveer. Baalveer gets the Pari Tara and is adamant about giving it to Natkhat Pari, Rani Pari must stop this from happening.

videos.title: Bhayankar Pari Turns Into Stone
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari fights Rani Pari for the Pari Tara. It gets massive and Bhayankar Pari challenges Rani Pari to identify the real Bhayankar Pari or else she will turn into a stone. Baalveer uses his powers to help Rani Pari. After returning to Pari Lok, Rani Pari decides to help the children who were captured by Bhayankar Pari.

videos.title: Baalveer Rushes To Rescue Kids
videos.overview: Baalveer saves another kid from Montu. Ballu goes missing and Mahesh's wife is tensed. Baalveer fights goons who are trying to kidnap school kids, meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari gets turned into stone. Will Baalveer be able to save the kids from the kidnappers? Will Bhayankar Pari finally take her revenge?

videos.title: Baalveer's First Day At School
videos.overview: Dooba Dooba overhears Naraz and Taraz Pari's conversation. He blackmails them into a unique task. Naraz and Taraz Pari tries to contact Tauba Tauba and inform him, but instead get to know Tauba Tauba's big master plan. Watch this episode to find out what Tauba Tauba was planning.

videos.title: Naraz Pari Reveals Her Master Plan
videos.overview: Naraz and Taraz Pari put up an act in front of Tauba Tauba who is disguised as Dooba Dooba. They try to teach him a lesson. On the other hand, Baalveer teaches a lesson to Montu. While all this is happening, some goons are planning to take revenge from Baalveer. Watch now to find out what Baalveer does.

videos.title: Fight Between Goons And Baalveer
videos.overview: Baalveer fights the goons. Manav backs Ballu in front of their teacher, but Ballu wittily dodges all the questions. Baalveer seeks help from Natkhat Pari to solve Rocky's problem. Was Baalveer able to win with the goons? Will Natkhat Pari be able to help Baalveer this time? Watch this episode now to find out.

videos.title: Baaghi Chacha Shows Different World To Rocky
videos.overview: Dooba Dooba becomes Baagi Chacha and shows Rocky a different world. Dadaji as always finds himself in the same kind of problem. In Bhayanak Lok, Tauba Tauba comes to Bhayankar Pari with the magical water. Will Tauba Tauba be able to release Bhayankar Pari from the stone?

videos.title: A Huge Trouble For Dadaji
videos.overview: The whole of Dagli Parivar comes to help Babuji. He has got his foot stuck and when all the ideas fail, Ballu (Baalveer) comes up with an idea that scares Babuji off. Ballu convinces Babuji in the end. Watch now to find out if Ballu's idea will be a success?

videos.title: Baalveer Cures Dadaji
videos.overview: Meher defends Baalveer when Ballu makes fun of him. Manav and Meher pray to Rani Pari for their grandfather to heal quickly. Baagi Chacha comes back to take Rocky on another enjoyable ride and Baalveer visits Pari Lok to meet and greet all the fairies and tell him about his life on Prithvi Lok.

videos.title: Rocky And Baaghi Chacha's Mini Party
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari attacks Pari Lok once again, and Baalveer with all the fairies try to stop her. On Prithvi Lok, the adventures of Baagi Chacha and Rocky continue, meanwhile, in Bhayanak Lok, Bhayankar Pari's wand loses its magical powers. Will all the fairies be able to stop Bhayankar Pari? Will Bhayankar Pari's wand become just another wooden stick?

videos.title: Tabahi Emerges From Bhayank Lok
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari tells Tauba Tauba about her childhood, and they are looking for Tabahi for which they will need to search the whole of Bhayanak Lok. In Prithvi Lok, Montu and his friends plan another prank on Ballu, but Natkhat Pari doubts that something is wrong and tries to help Ballu.

videos.title: Tabahi On A Secret Mission
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari meets Tabahi and explains her plan to destroy Baalveer. Tabahi goes to the school disguised as a teacher and is set to fight Baalveer and gain all his powers. Find out this episode to find out whether Tabahi succeeds and brings Baalveer to Bhayankar Pari.

videos.title: Tabahi Reveals Her Master Plan
videos.overview: Gaal Pari is helping kids who are poor in maths and reveals her secret to Aarpaar Pari. Bhatkat Pari comes to Gaal Pari with a bigger problem with kids all over the country. In Prithvi Lok, Tabahi becomes the school principal and scares the kids. Will she succeed in her plan?

videos.title: Tabahi Has A Good News
videos.overview: Tabahi and Tauba Tauba traps Baalveer and captures his superpowers. They go to Bhayank Lok to reveal the good news to Bhayankar Pari. In Dagli house, Rocky is having a great time with Baagi Chacha. What will be Tabahi's next move? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Montu Challenges Manav
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari is all praises for Tabahi and plans their next move. Mahesh and his whole family are very grateful to Baalveer for helping them every time. But outside Manav and his friends get into a heated argument with Montu and his friends and challenge them for a cricket match.

videos.title: Cricket Challenge Between Baalveer and Montu
videos.overview: The exciting cricket match beings and it is Montu who is on strike and Manav has to take his wicket. The challenge gets more interesting hen Ballu gets involve. Tabahi with Tauba Tauba prepares for another attack on Baalveer. Who will win the match? What is Tabahi going to do next?

videos.title: Tabahi Attacks Manav
videos.overview: Tabahi traps Manav for her next plan and Baalveer comes to save him. Tabahi captures another power from Baalveer and brings good news to Bhayankar Pari. Baal visits Pari Lok to understand why one of his powers did not work.

videos.title: School Bus Goes Out Of Control
videos.overview: Tabahi's next attack is on a school bus filled with kids. Baalveer comes to the rescue but more of his powers are not working. He uses Gaal Pari's power, but this allows Tabahi to steal another one of Baalveer's power. Tauba Tauba and Bhayankar Pari visit Tabahi in school.

videos.title: Baalveer Gets A Gift From Santa Claus
videos.overview: Baalveer visits Pari Lok where the fairies are preparing for Christmas. Santa Claus gives a huge gift to Baalveer. In Prithvi Lok Montu is again troubling Manav, but Manav seeks for Baalveer's help. Baalveer gives Manav something to protect himself.

videos.title: Manav's Special Paltu Baan
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba disguises himself as Dooba Dooba and meets Baalveer to test his powers. This comes as a great opportunity for him to steal another one of Baalveer's superpower. Manav uses Baalveer's gift on his father instead of Montu. Watch this episode to find out what will Manav's father do? Will Tauba Tauba be successful?

videos.title: Santa Claus Shocked To See Tabahi
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba accidentally reveals Bhayankar Pari's and Tabahi's plan in front of Baalveer. Baalveer decides to punish them, but hey disappear. Manav, Meher, and Rani Pari are busy in Christmas preparations so Baalveer takes matter in his own hands. Bhayankar Pari still has 5 of Baalveer's powers.

videos.title: Tabahi Kidnaps Santa Claus
videos.overview: Tabahi forces Baalveer to use another one of his powers, she captures Santa Claus and Baalveer goes to Bhayank Lok to save him where Tabahi is waiting for him. Manav uses his instrument wrongly again. How will Baalveer save Santa Claus without losing his powers? Baalveer and Tabahi have a massive fight.

videos.title: Snowfall In Manav and Meher's House
videos.overview: Baalveer saves Santa Claus and gifts Manav and Meher making them happy. Bhayankar Pari has captured six of Baalveer's seven powers and needs only one more. Tabahi has a perfect plan to attack Baalveer. Baalveer must save his powers at all costs.

videos.title: Dooba Dooba And Baalveer's Plan
videos.overview: Baalveer with Dooba Dooba plans to fool Bhayankar Pari. They must know the secret to Tabahi's powers and how to win against her, but that is not all, they must take all the powers back from Bhayankar Pari. Watch this episode to find out if Baalveer and Dooba Dooba succeeds in their plan.

videos.title: Baalveer's Magic Of Confusion
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari visits Prithvi Lok to destroy everything but soon realizes that she has been tricked. Tabua Tabua tells Bhayankar Pari about what happened. Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari are in a face-off, Bhayankar Pari asks Tabahi for her help. Will Baalveer emerge victoriously or will Tabahi win in this fight?

videos.title: Baalveer Destroys Magical Stick
videos.overview: Baalveer tricks Tabahi and Bhayankar Pari. They get in a massive fight, which leaves Tabahi frightened and scared. She tries to run away, but Baalveer puts an end to her and destroy's Bhayankar Pari's wand. What will Bhayankar Pari do now? How will she fight Baalveer? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Munna Makcha Threatens Tauba Tauba
videos.overview: Bhayankar Pari is looking for someone who will help her in defeating Baalveer. Munna Macchar with his army comes to meet Bhayankar Pari but Tauba Tauba stops him. In Dagli house, Manav and Meher are excited to know that Dadi will recite them a story tonight.

videos.title: A Deal Between Munna Makhchar and Bhayankar Pari
videos.overview: Munna Macchar meets Bhayankar Pari and they agree to a deal where Mumma and his army will bite the kids in Prithvi Lok and in exchange Bhayankar Pari will increase their life span. Baalveer visits Pari Lok and gets an instrument that will allow him to see the future.

videos.title: Baalveer's Special Mantra
videos.overview: Montu is again bulling the kids and Baalveer comes to stop him. Manav and Meher see their future in Baalveer binoculars. In Bhayankar Lok, Munna calls the whole army to explain what they need to do to live longer.

videos.title: Munna and Lemon Juice
videos.overview: Mumma Macchar and his gang are out to do their job, they are looking for lemon juice. In Bhayanak Lok, Bhayankar Pari reveals to Tauba Tauba that she plans to fool Munna. Will Manav and Meher get attacked buy Mumma's gang or will Baalveer save them? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Boarding School
videos.overview: Munna Macchar has entered the school with his gang and is ready to achieve their goal. Whereas, Manav and Meher are avoiding going to boarding school, for that they have to nice all the time. Lipstick and her friends make fun of Munna and his friends.

videos.title: Munna Proposes Lipstick
videos.overview: Manav asks Dadi about his father's plan on sending both the kids to boarding school. Baalveer tries to see Manav and Meher's future in his Bhavisya Bin. On the other hand, Munna Macchar proposes to Lipstick. Will Lipstick accept his proposal? Will Manav and Meher go to boarding school? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Trip With Family
videos.overview: Montu has finally changed and Baalveer decides to be his friend, but first Montu must pass Baalveer's test. Mahesh is taking his family for a trip and everyone is excited. Tauba Tauba accidentally tells Munna the truth. Watch this hilarious episode to see what happens with everyone.

videos.title: Munna Attacks
videos.overview: Munna Macchar and his gang try to enter Manav's classroom and bite the students. The kids start to feel sleepy, and Baalveer must save Manav and Meher. Montu insults Baalveer but quickly apologizes. Meanwhile, Baagi Chacha is visiting Rocky and they are having fun.

videos.title: Baalveer Pleads
videos.overview: Baalveer visits Bhayankar Pari and pleads her to stop the attack on the kids. Munna Macchar on the other hand is planning to attack Manav and Meher and he is waiting for just the right moment to do it. Lipstick decides to marry Munna Macchar.

videos.title: Pari Lok Comes To Help
videos.overview: Baalveer contacts Nathkat Pari for a solution, all the fairies get involved to help Baalveer. Tauba Tauba becomes Naraz Pari and Baalveer follows Munna Macchar. Are Munna Macchar and his army going to attack Baalveer?

videos.title: Naraz And Taraz Pari Gives An Update
videos.overview: Naraz and Taraz Pari make contact with Bhayankar Pari to update her on what is going on in Pari Lok. Tauba Tauba becomes an obstacle and stops Baalveer from helping Manav and Meher. Manav and Meher are worried that they would be sent to boarding school.

videos.title: Fight Against Mosquitoes
videos.overview: Manav and Meher finally get to know the truth about boarding school and skip a trip to complete an important task. The kids are going to fight against the mosquitoes by cleanliness. Will the kids succeed or will Munna Macchar and his army win?

videos.title: Munna And Lipstick
videos.overview: Baalveer and the fairies in Pari Lok find a solution to destroy all the mosquitoes and cure the kids. Bhayankar Pari reveals her plan to Tauba Tauba and Munna Macchar saves Lipstick. Watch this episode to find out if Bhayankar Pari will successfully fool Munna Macchar.

videos.title: Munna Changes Sides
