videos.overview: Rani Pari decides to draw the evil out of Mahavinashini and turn her into a good Pari. For her plan to be successful, Balveer will have to procure the 'White Arrows of Happiness'. He only has six hours to accomplish his mission. Can Balveer do it?

videos.title: Manav's Tale Of Intelligence
videos.overview: Balveer is in a race against time to get the white arrows and return to Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and Shatir Pari are plotting to use the 'Charan Jakad Yantra' to trap Bal Veer. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Attack On Mahavinashni
videos.overview: The Paris and Balveer have launched a counterattack against Mahavinashini in order to set her on the right path. Meanwhile, Montu has been standing under a coconut tree, just waiting for a coconut to fall on his head after hearing Manav's story. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: White Bolt
videos.overview: The white arrows seemingly had no effect on Mahavinashini and she escaped. After getting hit by several coconuts, Montu has become a genius and is celebrating in school. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Changing Behavior
videos.overview: Balveer along with the Paris goes to Vinash Lok so that they can observe Mahavinashini's behaviour. Meanwhile in school, Montu's teacher decides to test his newfound intelligence. Can Mahavinashini turn over a new leaf? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Apology
videos.overview: In Pari Lok, Mahavinashini is being treated to extract all the evil out of her. Balveer has his doubts about her behaviour. Meanwhile, Montu has realized that Manav fooled him and now wants to pay him back. Is Bal Veer's suspicion true? Keep watching the show to find out.

videos.title: Satya Samarpan Pahad
videos.overview: To prove that Mahavinashini has turned good, Rani Pari has decided that she along with Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari will have to walk on the empty space between two mountains. If she is able to do that, then it will mean that she truly has had a change of heart. Will Mahavinashini pass this trial? Stay tuned and find out.

videos.title: Sachi And Achhi Pari
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari are being held in a cage after failing Rani Pari's test of truth. They feel that Mahavinashini has turned into a good Pari and has abandoned their quest of spreading evil. Meanwhile, Montu and Rohit are at Dagli house and are taking their revenge on Manav and Meher.

videos.title: Army Of Sachai And Achhai
videos.overview: Rani Pari takes all the Paris and Baalveer to Earth where she reveals a secret Laboratory. Meanwhile, Manav and Meher attempt to trick Montu again and temporarily save themselves from him.

videos.title: Protectors Of Goodness
videos.overview: Rani Pari explains the purpose of the army and the four chief generals to all the Paris and Baalveer. Meanwhile, Montu is trying to attain intelligence by standing upside down. Find out more by watching the episode.

videos.title: Awakening Of Warriors
videos.overview: Rani Pari is going to breathe life into the army by reading a mantra from the 'Sena Sanjeevani' Book. However, Mahavinashini plans to use the army for her own evil deeds and is just putting on the act of being good. Keep watching to find out what will happen next.

videos.title: Four Warriors Of Truth
videos.overview: Mahavinashini is trying her best to stop Rani Pari from bringing her army to life. However, the collective efforts of Bal Veer and the Paris are enough to prevent that from happening. What will Mahavinashini do now? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Trap For Warriors
videos.overview: Baalveer and the Paris have figured out how Mahavinashini deceived them and was able to pass the difficult test. Meanwhile, the four warriors of truth arrive at Vinash Lok to capture Mahavinashini. Keep watching to find out more.

videos.title: Slave Of Darkness
videos.overview: Mahavinashini has trapped the four warriors of truth in Vinash Lok and is now going to turn them into servants of evil. Meanwhile, Montu has set up a trap for Manav and Meher in their own home. What does Mahavinashini plan to do with these four warriors? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Hidden Army Of Truth
videos.overview: Mahavinashini tries to retain the army by threatening Rani Pari. However, Rani Pari has hidden the army in a place which cannot be accessed by anyone. How will Mahavinashini react now?

videos.title: Baalveer Fights Evil Generals
videos.overview: The four generals come to Pari Lok for Rani Pari but Bal Veer stands in their way. Meanwhile, Montu has set a trap for Manav so that he will lose in the challenge. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

videos.title: Immortal Generals
videos.overview: Baalveer tries to end the four generals but fails to do so as all of them are immortal and cannot be killed. At school, Montu plays a prank on his teacher to protect himself from punishment. His teacher finds out and now plans to teach Montu a lesson with Manav and Meher's help.

videos.title: Baalveer's Army
videos.overview: Baalveer manages to escape from the grasp of the four generals. Rani Pari has the key that will free up the army of truth and she divides it into four parts. One part she keeps for herself and the other three she gives to three different Paris. Will Mahavinashini get her hands on these keys? Find out in this episode

videos.title: Generals Of Baalveer's Army
videos.overview: Baalveer is looking for kids who can become the new generals for the army of truth. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari inform Mahavinashini about the four keys. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: The Army Generals
videos.overview: Baalveer has found his three generals who will lead the army of truth at the school's Christmas carnival. But things are about to get problematic as Lohavaar and Vajrvaar arrive on Earth with the purpose of harming the kids. What is Bal Veer going to do now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Shaatir Pari Troubles Baalveer
videos.overview: Baalveer surrenders in front of Lohavaar and Vajrvaar and they take him to Pari Lok where Bal Pari is hiding. Shatir Pari threatens to end Baalveer's life if Bal Pari doesn't come out and hands over the last piece of the key. Will Bal Pari reveal herself? Watch the full episode to find out more.

videos.title: Baalveer's Warriors
videos.overview: Baalveer convinces Manav, Meher and Montu to work together so that they can stop the four generals. Rani Pari comes to Earth and gives the three of them their powers. Baalver's army is now ready to take on the servants of evil.

videos.title: Baalveer's Best Warrior
videos.overview: Rani Pari gives Manav, Meher and Montu their weapons which will aid them in their fight against the four generals. But the three of them are unable to pick up their weapons. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini comes to the school and calls out Rani Pari by threatening the lives of children. Can Baalveer's army be ready in time to face the imposing force of evil?

videos.title: Army Of The Devils
videos.overview: The lives of school kids are being threatened by Mahavinashini and her accomplices. Meanwhile, Manav, Meher and Montu are training hard to become fit for the role of a hero. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Challenge To Rani Pari
videos.overview: A situation of Panic has been created on Earth by Mahavinashini. She has captured children and is holding them for ransom in exchange for the 4th part of the key. Meanwhile, Manav, Meher and Montu are still preparing for their roles as heroes. Can they finish their preparations in time? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Fight Of Truth
videos.overview: Baalveer's team is finally ready to take on the four generals. However, the captured children have been surrounded by fire through Mahavinashini's magic. How wil our heroes save the kids now? Find out right here.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Army
videos.overview: Rani Pari and Baalveer have been successful in separating Mahavinashini from her generals. Meanwhile, Baalveer is planning an ambush on the four generals with Manav, Meher and Montu's help. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Last Potion Of Magical Key
videos.overview: Mahavinashini has sent out fake soldiers to deceive Baalveer. At the same time, the captured kids have been locked inside a school bus and the soldiers are going to push that bus downhill. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Children's Army
videos.overview: The fourth general is in hiding. Bal Veer and his team can't figure out a way to defeat the four generals as they keep reviving back. Rani Pari advises Baalveer and the kids to defeat all of them at once in order to end them for good. Will they find the fourth general? Only one way to find out.

videos.title: Montu Is Scared
videos.overview: Montu abandons Baalveer's team and agrees to help the evil four generals to support and end the good guys. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and her lackeys are off to find the hidden army with the help of the key. Find out more by watching the episode.

videos.title: Donation For Noble Cause
videos.overview: It was Montu's plan all along, pretending to be on the side of evil just to smoke out the fourth general. However, Mahavianshini has successfully awakened the hidden army. Can Baalveer and his friends defeat the four generals and stop Mahavinashini's army?

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Oath
videos.overview: Mahavinashini has assembled her army and has ordered them to destroy Baalveer and all the Paris of Pari Lok. Rani Pari still has faith, that Baalveer and his friends will be able to defeat the insurmountable odds posed by the forces of evil. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: Gayabkar Yantra
videos.overview: Montu tries to cancel the school's New Year's part but Baalveer teaches him a lesson. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba comes to know that the Paris will lose their powers between 8 to 12 and plots to steal something important from them. Catch all the excitement on this episode of Baalveer.

videos.title: Magical Treasure
videos.overview: Rani Pari decides to trick Mahavinashini by sending Dooba Dooba 1, dressed as Tauba Tauba to Vinash Lok. In the meantime, Bhatkati Pari, Vijdhaar Pari and Dooba Doobas make their way towards Earth, so that they can help Baalveer with his new year's party.

videos.title: New Year Bash
videos.overview: The kids receive Baalveer's magical invitation for his new year's party. Montu and Rohit are trying to spoil the fun by creating hindrances in the preparation. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and Shatir Pari are making their way towards Pari Lok. Have they figured out that Rani Pari has tricked them? Will Montu spoil the fun of the party? Keep watching to find answers to all your questions.

videos.title: Baalveer's New Year Party
videos.overview: The kids are amazed by the fantastic decoration as they enter the hall for the party. Baalveer and the Paris treat all of them with ice creams and chocolates. Elsewhere, Mahavinashini comes to know the truth which Rani was trying to hide. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

videos.title: Montu's Failed Plan
videos.overview: Montu tries to spoil Manav and Meher's performance but Baalveer stops him. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari are also at the party in a different get-up, looking for Baalveer. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: Montu And Babli's Friendship
videos.overview: Shatir Pari arrives at the venue on her secret mission to look for the Paris. Meanwhile, Montu is giving Rohit a hard time for exposing all his plans. Stay tuned for more.

videos.title: Sand Watch
videos.overview: Baalveer gets the idea of adding more sand to the hourglass. But for this, he will need some help. Thankfully, Manav, Meher and Montu are more than willing to aid their favourite superhero. Can Baalveer save all the Paris by regaining his powers? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Plan For Baalveer's Birthday
videos.overview: It is Ballu and Meher's birthday and the Dagli household is very excited about it. Meanwhile, Pari Lok is also preparing for Baalveer's birthday but Rani Pari is worried that Mahavinashini might make things difficult.

videos.title: Rani Pari's Surprise Party
videos.overview: Meher has been strange for the past couple of days. Manav and Ballu are worried and decide to investigate the reason behind her strange behaviour. In Pari Lok, the Paris have planned a surprise party for Baalveer and they don't want Mahavinashini finding out about it. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Protective Sheild
videos.overview: Rani Pari has surrounded Pari Lok with a protective shield to protect it from evil forces. Meanwhile, Hasi and Khushi Pari invite all of Baalveer's friends to his surprise birthday party. Catch all the other exciting things that happened, on this episode of Baalveer.

videos.title: Montu's Dream
videos.overview: Hasi and Khushi Pari have accidentally invited Chittu to Baalveer's birthday party, not knowing that he actually is Tauba Tauba in disguise. Pari Lok is looking beautiful with all the decorations for Baalveer's birthday and they are ready to host their guests. Want to know more? Then continue watching this episode.

videos.title: Mahavinshni's War
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba informs Mahavinashini about the surprise birthday party for Baalveer. She decides to poison the grapes that will be used for Baalveer's birthday cake. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Fight With Mahavinashni
videos.overview: Mahavinashini tries to break the protective barrier around Pari Lok but is unsuccessful in doing so. However, the Paris suspect that Mahavinashini knows about Baalveer's birthday party and decide to pass on the wrong information about the venue. Find out more in this episode.

videos.title: Invisible Site For Festival
videos.overview: All the kids have assembled on the ground to go to Pari Lok for Baalveer's birthday party. Meanwhile, Dooba Dooba 1 and 4 try to stop Baalveer from entering Pari Lok so that the surprise doesn't get spoiled. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Festive Island
videos.overview: All the invited kids are travelling to Pari Lok in a magical, flying bus! Baalveer has also reached Pari Lok but can't seem to find anyone around. Stay tuned to find out what will happen next.

videos.title: Magical Security Gate
videos.overview: The magical security gate installed at the entrance will not let anyone with bad intentions enter the party venue. Mahavinashini finds out about the real venue of the party through Tauba Tauba and she tries to enter with the help of a disguise.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Deadly Plan
videos.overview: Mahavinashini has entered Baalveer's birthday party in the form of a small girl. All the kids seem to be having a lot of fun at the party but for how long? What will Mahavinashini do to spoil the party's fun?

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Poison
videos.overview: It is Baalveer's birthday party and all the children have arrived at Pari Lok to celebrate! To make the celebrations even grander, singer Preeti Bhalla is there to sing the kids their favourite songs. But, Mahavinashini also reaches the party in a disguise. What evil tricks has she planned this time? Will the Paris and Baalveer be successful in saving the kids?

videos.title: Poisonous Cake
videos.overview: After eating the cake at Baalveer's party, all the kids fall to sleep. Baalveer himself feels weakened. Mahavinashini returns to her original form and threatens to end all of them for good. Can Baalveer recover in time to spoil the evil Mahavinashini's plan? Watch the full episode to find out.

videos.title: Effect Of The Poisonous Cake
videos.overview: The three Paris and Baalveer leave to bring back various items from Pari Lok and Madhya Saagar. Mahavinashini has poisoned the water around the Pavitra Tree! Now it falls on Baalveer to bring the Pure Moti and save all the kids from Mahavinashini's poison. But a shark is in the Kund, protecting the Pure Moti. How will Baalveer get out of this?

videos.title: Magical Pearls
videos.overview: Baalveer finally managed to take the Pure Moti back. Mahavinashini was unsuccessful in her efforts to stop him from reaching Pari Lok. All the kids are back to normal and return home safely. It is a time for festivities! Meanwhile, Mhavinashini and Shatir Pari are contemplating on their loss.

videos.title: Pari Lok's Identity
videos.overview: Mahagajni establishes the pillar of truth in Pari Lok, as Rani Pari explains its importance to Baalveer and the Paris. Neil and Saloni are getting admitted into the school but are threatened by Montu on their very first day. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba is planning to blow away Pari Lok with a bomb from a mountain top. Will he be successful?

videos.title: Montu Learns A Lesson
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba fails to throw the bomb at Pari Lok and returns to Vinash Lok all burnt up. After hearing his story, Mahvinashini realizes that there is an active volcano in one of those five mountains. She learns of a monster that was trapped in there by the Paris and decides to free it.

videos.title: Burning Monster
videos.overview: In school, Neil sees the notice for a boxing tournament and decides to participate in it. He doesn't know that the school bully, Montu, will also be a part of it. Shatir Pari and Tauba Tauba are unable to wake Agnikal from his sleep. Tauba Tauba kicks Agnikal's leg in frustration and he opens his eye.

videos.title: Neil Participates Against Montu
videos.overview: Agnikal wakes up from his sleep and vows to attack Pari Lok for what they did to him. Neil is afraid and tense, after realizing that his boxing match is with Montu. Baalveer and all the Paris are shocked to see the Pavitra Nadi overflowing. What could be the reason?

videos.title: Neil Beats Montu Up
videos.overview: Neil goes to withdraw his name from the boxing match after learning that he has to face Montu. Rani Pari tells Baalveer about Agnikal and he decides to challenge him. At the same time, Agnikal and Mahavinashini have joined hands to destroy Pari Lok. What will happen now?

videos.title: Agnikaal's Deceptive Powers
videos.overview: With no option other than to fight, Neil starts preparing for his boxing match. Baalveer's attacks have no effect on Agnikal. His body catches fire as Agnikall approaches him. The situation is looking dire for the great Baalveer. How will he overcome this obstacle?

videos.title: Agnikaal Defeats Baalveer
videos.overview: After his battle with Agnikal, Baalveer is badly injured. Mahavinashini decides to spare his life and sends his unconscious body to the Pari Lok as a statement. Manish, Neil's school friend, has an idea for defeating Montu in the boxing match. Agnikal reaches Pari Lok along with Mahavinashini and her accomplices. Watch the episode to find out what happens.

videos.title: Conspiracy To Ruin Pari Lok
videos.overview: Agnikal has activated the Volcano! He plans to burn the whole Pari Lok with the hot lava. Neil and Manish play pranks on Montu and make him believe that Neil got stronger than him by drinking that booster syrup. Watch the full episode to find out other exciting things that happened.

videos.title: Neil Challenges Montu
videos.overview: After witnessing Neil's strength, Montu feels extremely scared and wants to withdraw from the competition. Baalveer and the Paris are feeling helpless against the volcano's lava. They are unable to retrieve the water from Pavitra Nadi which is needed to stop the volcano. Suddenly, Baalveer gets an idea. Watch the episode to find out what is his idea to stop the crisis.

videos.title: Montu Follows Gandhi's Ideology
videos.overview: After witnessing Neil's strength, Montu feels extremely scared and wants to withdraw from the competition. Baalveer and the Paris are feeling helpless against the volcano's lava. They are unable to retrieve the water from Pavitra Nadi which is needed to stop the volcano. Suddenly, Baalveer gets an idea. Watch the episode to find out what is his idea to stop the crisis.

videos.title: Threat On Pari Lok
videos.overview: The volcano's lava is slowly moving towards Pari Lok, which has the Paris extremely worried. Montu did not take his name out of the boxing match which has shocked Manish and Neil. Baalveer is trying to dig a tunnel to get the water of Pavitra to Pari Lok but problems keep following him. Tune in to find out how he is going to solve them.

videos.title: The Boxing Match
videos.overview: Neil's parents are boosting his confidence and praying for his win as the much-awaited boxing match is finally here. Elsewhere, Baalveer is unable to bring the water of Pavitra Nadi to Pari Lok. He decides to unearth the Pillar of Truth which will help him get the water to Pari Lok. What is Baalveer's plan? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's Protective Sheild
videos.overview: The volcano which was activated by Agnikal has caused a lot of destruction in Pari Lok. He is trying to convince Mahavinashini to undo the security barrier so that he can himself enter Pari Lok. In the boxing match, Neil uses his agility to gain an advantage over Montu. Find out all that has happened by tuning in to this episode of Baalveer.

videos.title: The End Of Agnikaal
videos.overview: The boxing match has reached its final round. The audience is cheering for Neil but Montu tries to win by using unfair means. Baalveer has figured out a way to spread the water across Pari Lok. However, Agnikal is about to destroy the Pillar of Truth. Will Neil and Baalveer be able to figure out a way to come out on top?

videos.title: Go Green Movement
videos.overview: Baalveer is trying to raise awareness about the 'Go Green movement'u among the people. However, Montu tries to spoil the greenery and Baalveer is inclined to teach him a lesson. In Vinash Lok, Mahavinashini has awoken a dangerous monster which will prove to be extremely threatening for Baalveer and all of Pari Lok.

videos.title: Magical Seeds
videos.overview: A new and deadly threat has emerged! The Mahadanav has sown the magical seed which will help him eradicate all of Earth's greenery. In school, Baalveer warns Montu to not trouble the other kids, but he doesn't listen. Rohit has to tie him up against a pole in order to stop him from committing mischief. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Montu Is Excused
videos.overview: Upon seeing Baalveer in the garden, Mahadanav runs away but drops his bag of magical seeds. Montu is still not done with his mischief and starts scaring the kids by making Rohit wear a ghost mask. Meanwhile, the Minister informs Baalveer that all of Earth's greenery is getting depleted. What could be the cause? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Danger To Earth
videos.overview: Upon hearing about the Earth's greenery depleting, Baalveer and the other Paris of Pari Lok get worried. Montu is up to his usual mischief and tries to use Neil for target practice. Due to the depleting oxygen levels, people on Earth begin to faint. Pari Lok decides to send out oxygen in balloons in order to save them. Find out if they will be able to save the people, in this episode of Baalveer.

videos.title: Miracle Of The Seeds
videos.overview: Mahadanav finds Saloni on top of the tree that was created by the magical seed and captures her inside a cage. Rani Pari has found a temporary solution so that the people of Earth can breathe, but they need to quickly get to the root of the problem. Baalveer returns to Earth and finds the huge tree. Keep watching to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Mahadanav's Plan
videos.overview: After climbing up the tree, Baalveer has landed up in Danav Lok. His magical powers don't seem to work in this world. He hears Saloni calling out in the distance and goes to investigate. Will he be able to save Saloni in time? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Threat To Saloni
videos.overview: After some efforts, Baalveer is successful in rescuing Saloni from falling into the tiger pit. Saloni tells him about Mahadanav's master plan to eradicate Earth's greenery. What will be Baalveer's next move? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Mahadanav's Devotion
videos.overview: Earth's oxygen is depleting at a rapid pace and most of the greenery has dried up. Saloni and Baalveer manage to distract Mahadanav and steal the bottle of greenery. Meanwhile on Earth, Neil and Manish call all the kids together to take revenge on Montu. Will Montu learn the lesson? Will Saloni and Baalveer manage to escape from Danav Lok? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Encounter With Mahadanav
videos.overview: Saloni makes her way down the giant tree to escape from Danav Lok, but Mahdanav follows her footsteps to retrieve his bottle of greenery. Baalveer has also regained his consciousness and is now going to confront the Mahadanav on Earth.

videos.title: Maha Bed's Ethology
videos.overview: Mahavinashini retrieves the 'Mahabed Shastra' from the 'Mayavi Agni' which can supposedly break through the protective shield around Ballu, Baalveer's alter-ego. She hands over the Mahabhed Shastra to Shatir Pari and sends her off to attack Ballu. Can Shatir Pari bring this evil plan to success? Continue watching to find.

videos.title: Conspiracy Against Baalveer
videos.overview: After failing in her first attempt of attacking Ballu, Shatir Pari lands on Pari Lok and takes on the disguise of Baal Pari. Her mission is to find out details about Baalveer's protective shield. Find out more about her evil plan by watching this episode.

videos.title: Shatir Pari's New Conspiracy
videos.overview: Shatir Pari wants to learn the secret behind Baalveer's protective shield. Only Rani Pari knows how to remove it. Meanwhile, Neil and Saloni have challenged Montu to a fight. What is going to happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Shatir Pari's Trap
videos.overview: After learning about the mantra to remove Ballu's protective shield, Shatir Pari has come to Ballu's school and has taken on the disguise of a teacher. In Pari Lok, Baal Pari is awake and Rani Pari has sent two Paris to protect Baalveer. Can they reach him in time?

videos.title: Shatir Pari's Plan For Baalveer
videos.overview: Shatir Par is disguised as a teacher in Ballu's school and makes him read the mantra that will remove his protective shield. She attacks Ballu and he falls to the ground, unconscious. She then brings Ballu to Mahavinashini. What do they plan to do with him?

videos.title: Mahavinashni's New Trick
videos.overview: Shatir Pari and Mahavinashini reach Pari Lok to gloat over their victory. They announce to all the Paris that Baalveer is at Gilbill mountain, where all his powers will be extracted by Gilbill. What is going to happen now? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer Is Trapped
videos.overview: Baalveer is being held captive at Gilbill mountain where all his powers are being stripped away. As it happens, the power of Pari Lok is also weakening along with Baalveer. What can the Paris do to save him from this situation?

videos.title: The Magic Mirror
videos.overview: The Paris cannot enter Gilbill mountain to save Baalveer. In this terrible situation, Rani Pari turns to Manav and Meher, to go and save Baalveer from Gilbill. Will the two kids be able to save their good friend? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Neil To Beat Montu Again
videos.overview: Manav and Meher have successfully freed Baalveer from Gilbill's captivity and returned him to Pari Lok. But Mahavinashini has another evil trick up her sleeve left, and she plots an attack on Pari Lok. What is Mahavinashini's plan now? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Agnikaal's Powers
videos.overview: Mahavinashi has poisoned the air of Pari Lok, which has caused Aarpaar Pari to turn into sand. Rani Pari does know of a cure but the Paris will have to travel far for it. What is Mahavinashini's ultimate goal? Will Rani Pari be able to find a cure? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: The Deadly Poison
videos.overview: On Earth, Mahesh's mouth has been closed shut because of the glue. All his family members are looking for a way to open it up. Meanwhile, to cure the effects of the poison, Rani Pari wishes for an Amrit from the Vish Amrit mountain. Mahavinashini's plan is to wish for an elixir that will have an opposite effect. What will she do with such an elixir? Keep watching to find out

videos.title: Pari Lok In Trouble
videos.overview: Rani Pari takes the Amrit back to Pari Lok, to cure the effects of the poison. Mahavinashini gave the elixir she got from the mountain to Tauba Tauba. His task is to poison Baalveer with it. What will happen to Baalveer now? Keep watching the show to find out.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba On Mission
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba did not succeed in his initial attempt to poison Baalveer. He asks Mahavinashini for a second chance. This time he plans to pose as Bagicha-cha and poison Baalveer as he is playing with him and the other kids. Can he be successful this time in poisoning Baalveer? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer To Know Tauba Tauba's Trick
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba was successful in shrinking Manav, Meher, and Baalveer down to size. Dooba Dooba comes back to consciousness and informs all the Paris about the incident. Rani Pari sends Dooba Dooba 1 and Bhatkati Pari to investigate. Find out what happens next in this episode.

videos.title: Shortened Height Of Kids
videos.overview: Bhatkati Pari and Dooba Dooba 1 reach the Dagli house but are unable to spot Baalveer and his friends. Mahavinashini is furious with Tauba Tauba and sends him back on earth to look for Baalveer. Who will find Baalveer first? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba Looks For Kids
videos.overview: Tuaba Tauba is desperately searching for Baalveer and his friends. He decides to turn into Dagli house's servant so that he can easily look for them. Meanwhile, the other Paris have gone looking for a cure from the Vish Amrit Mountain. Will they be able to procure an antidote? Or will Tauba Tauba get to them first?

videos.title: Tauba Tauba's Changed Look
videos.overview: Mahesh and Bapuji have decided to keep Tauba Tauba as their servant. The children are hiding under the dining table and suddenly, Ballu gets an idea to alert the Paris by pressing the Buzzer of the Chetavani Yantra! Meanwhile, Bhatakti Pari has an encounter with Shatir Pari on the school grounds.

videos.title: Kids Are Found
videos.overview: Tauba Tuaba finds the kids hiding in the shirt pocket. Bhatkati Pari is still looking for the Amrit bottle on Earth. The kids must find another way to get to the Yantra before Tauba Tauba catches them. How will Baalveer get himself out of this situation?

videos.title: The Chetavni Yantra
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba continues his search for the kids. Baalveer seems to have finally found his way into the bedroom where the Chetavni Yantra is kept. Meanwhile, Montu and Rohit aren't able to handle themselves after eating a humongous burger. Keep up with all the excitement by watching this episode.

videos.title: Kids' Narrow Escape
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba finds the kids hiding inside the vacuum cleaner, but they manage to escape when Mahesh takes Tauba Tauba away from some work. Bhatakti Pari is finally able to retrieve the Amrit from Rohit and Montu. At the same time, The kids have found a way to Kick Tauba Tauba out of the house, for good.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba Gets Caught
videos.overview: The kids were successful in their plan and Tauba Tauba got kicked out of the house. They safely reach the Cetavni Yantra and send out a message for help. Mahavinashini is angry when Tauba Tauba returns empty-handed. She has sent Shatir Pari to finish the job this time. Will she be able to bring Baalveer to Vinash Lok?

videos.title: Fancy Dress
videos.overview: A suspicious man with a weird costume and a magical merry-go-round has arrived at school. Montu is busy flaunting his new, remote control car in front of his schoolmates. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba has also arrived on Earth with a strange tool.

videos.title: Mahavinashni To Kidnap Kids
videos.overview: It was Mahavinashini's plan to kidnap 21 kids in order to obtain the all-powerful Vajra. But she is disappointed when Riwana and Harun turn up with only 4. Now the Jhulewala has his eyes set on kidnapping Neil and Sonali. What is going to happen next? Stay tuned in to find out.

videos.title: Missing Kids
videos.overview: Baalveer is investigating the mystery of the missing children but is unable to place the Kidnapper even when he is right in front of him. Mahavinashini is disappointed in Harun and Riwana and wants them to speed up the process. Meanwhile, Bapuji has swallowed the magnetic pill which was earlier in Rohit's possession. What will happen now?

videos.title: Baalveer On Mission
videos.overview: Baalveer is desperately searching for the missing kids and goes to Pari Lok for help. Mahesh goes to the police station to inform them about Bapuji's strange condition. Elsewhere, the missing children seem to be having fun in the strange world they have arrived in.

videos.title: Kid's Planning
videos.overview: Baalveer has purposefully gotten himself kidnapped to figure out Harun and Riwana's plan. They have been successful in procuring 21 kids and will be transporting them to Mahavinashini. What is Baalveer planning to do? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Baalveer To Save Kids
videos.overview: Mahavinashini is unable to get the All-powerful Vajra. Ballu transforms into Baalveer and has an idea for obtaining the Vajra for himself. Who will get Vajra first? Baalveer or Mahavinashini? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Super Hero Baalveer
videos.overview: Baalveer and Mahavinashini are battling it out for the Vajra. Harun and Riwana have turned on Mahavinashini and are now going to help Baalveer in sending the kids home. What will happen next? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Dooba Dooba's Magical Broom
videos.overview: Rani Pari is not in Pari Lok and a huge meteor is headed towards Earth. Can the Paris and Baalveer find the cause behind the meteor and figure out a way to stop it before it collides with the Earth? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Mahavinashni's New Scheme
videos.overview: The looming threat of the meteorites moving towards the Earth is still there. But Bal Pari has seemingly got a solution from the magical history book. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba has run out of the white magical rock and goes to Shatir Pari for more.

videos.title: Mahabalis' Threat To Fairies
videos.overview: On Mahavinashini's orders, Shatir Pari has called upon the Mahabali brothers to destroy Baalveer. The meteor is heading towards the Earth at a very quick pace. All the Paris have come together to give Baalveer their powers. Will Blaveer stop the meteor? How powerful are the Mahabali brothers? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Shakti Vitran Smaroh
videos.overview: During the Shakti Vitran Samaroh, all the Paris are transferring their powers to Baalveer, to help him save the Earth. The Mahabali brothers have also arrived on Pari Lok. What do they plan to do? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Mahavinashni Traps Baalveer
videos.overview: The Mahabali brothers are stealing all of Baalveer's powers! Meanwhile, the meteor is moving towards the Earth and Baalveer is the only one who can stop it. What will happen now? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Powers Are Back
videos.overview: The Paris bring all of Baalveer's powers back by chanting the Mool mantra. Now he plans on teaching them a lesson. On Earth, Manav finds out that the woman who goes by the title 'BBM', is a fraud. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Bhoot Bhagao Mission
videos.overview: Students get to know the truth about the ghost that has been tormenting them for so long. Baalveer has regained his powers from Mahabali and is now going to save the Earth from the oncoming meteorite.

videos.title: Natkhat Pari Returns
videos.overview: Natkhat Pari has returned to Pari Lok and all the Paris are reminiscing on their childhood memories. On Earth, Montu has given Neil, Saloni, and their friends a challenge. Watch the episode to catch up on all the excitement.

videos.title: The Magical Ring
videos.overview: Manav and Meher have accidentally reached Pari Lok through the Magic ring which Natkhat Pari gave to Dooba Dooba 1. Meanwhile, Neil, Saloni, and their friends are still trying to beat Montu in his own challenge. Keep watching to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Montu's Viral Video
videos.overview: Montu has been troubling the school kids and Baalveer goes to teach him a lesson. At the same time, Manav, Meher, and their family members are taking a tour around Pari Lok. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Poisonous Shrubs
videos.overview: Natkhat Pari has become the Dagli Family's tour guide around Pari Lok. Shatir Pari is back at her evil deeds, as she plants a poisonous seed in Pari Lok. Meanwhile, on Earth, Montu and Rohit are planning to cheat during their exam. What is this seed gonna do? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Baalveer In Ghatak Lok
videos.overview: Natkhat Pari is showing the Dagli family around Pari Lok. Baalveer has entered Ghatak Lok to find a solution for the poisonous branches. In school, Saloni and Neil try to teach Montu so that he doesn't have to cheat on the exam. Find out more by watching the episode.

videos.title: Pari Lok In Danger
videos.overview: Shatir Pari has put the lives of everyone in Pari Lok in danger, by surrounding it with deadly, poisonous branches. The Dagli family who are enjoying their trip, are unaware of this danger. In Ghatak Lok, Baalveer has fallen into a pit but has Mahayoddha to help him out. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Baalveer Saves Pari Lok
videos.overview: The poisonous branches have completely engulfed Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Baalveer is still stuck in Ghatak Lok with Mahayoddha. Who is going to save Pari Lok in this great time of need? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Montu's Burger Mela
videos.overview: The captain of the school cricket team is being selected and all the students have assembled in the playground. To ensure that Montu gets the position, he tries to bribe everyone with burgers to get the maximum vote. Meanwhile, strange events have begun in space.

videos.title: Khatal Posing A Threat To Earth
videos.overview: Aliens have offered the Earth as a gift to their King, Hansmatol on his birthday. He tries to play around with the globe which has serious repercussions on Earth. Find out what happens next in this episode.

videos.title: Baalveer Challenges Hansmatol
videos.overview: Baalveer has to save the Earth from King Hansmatol. He tries to reason with him by making him understand that the Earth is not a cricket ball. However, Hansmatol pays no heed to Baalveer's concerns. Now Baalveer has challenged him to a cricket match. Find out more by watching this episode.

videos.title: Baalveer's Tip
videos.overview: Baalveer informs Rani Pari of the threat that Hansmatol has brought to the Earth. Now he begins practising with the kids for the cricket match that will save their world. Will the kids be successful in defeating Hansmatol? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: The Sports Competition
videos.overview: Baalveer and his team are practising hard for their cricket match against King Hansmatol and his team of aliens. While Hansmatol is adamant in winning the match, by hook or by crook.

videos.title: Baalveer Vs Hasmatol
videos.overview: The cricket match between Baalveer's team and Hansmatol's team has begun! The fate of the Earth hangs in the balance. Though, Hansmatol doesn't believe in playing fair and is utilizing all his magical powers to get the win. Can Baalveer's team find a way to overcome this situation? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Dharti Premiere League
videos.overview: The cricket match continues between Baalveer and Hansmatol's teams. The King of Shatir Lok has given his teammates full freedom to use magic for collecting as many runs as possible. At the same time, they are making it difficult for Baalveer's team to get ahead in the match. Can Baalveer and the kids pull out a victory? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's New Avtaar
videos.overview: Grand preparations are happening in Pari Lok but Natkhat Pari has no clue why. Meanwhile, All the kids go for a field trip with their teacher. Continue watching to find out what the preparations are for.

videos.title: Threat To Paris' Life
videos.overview: During the archaeological trip, the whole structure started rumbling and the Earth started. However, all the kids managed to escape from there safely. Although, from the depths of the cave a new threat has emerged who wishes to destroy all of Pari Lok and its Paris. Who exactly is he? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Special Powers
videos.overview: The new threat that emerged from the cave is no one else but the Guru of all Paris of Pari Lok. But for some reason, he feels that they have betrayed him and he now wants to enact his revenge on them. Meanwhile, a new student has joined AVP Vidyamandir and all the boys seem pleasantly surprised to see her.

videos.title: Montu's Mission To Impress Monica
videos.overview: The battle between Guru Dev and Baalveer carries on! He believes that all Paris have turned evil, while Baalveer tries to reason with him. In school, all the boys are trying their best to impress Monica, the new girl.

videos.title: Gurudev Is Angry
videos.overview: Guru Dev is getting furious by the minute, while the Paris are observing his actions from Pari Lok. Montu has arranged a Yacht party to impress Monica. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Prithvilok In Danger
videos.overview: Montu's party is going on and all the kids are having a great time in the middle of the sea. Meanwhile, Gurudev has caused massive calamities across the earth which has put the kids in harm's way. Can Baalveer save the kids from Guru Dev's wrath?

videos.title: Manav and Meher's Life At Risk
videos.overview: Guru Dev calls upon one of his disciples to aid him in the war he is about to wage on Pari Lok. All the kids are stuck in a sinking yacht and are crying out for Baalveer to help them. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Manav And Meher's New Avtaar
videos.overview: Manav and Meher appear in a new avatar as Rani Pari imbibes both of them with powers. Meher will now be known as Bal Sakhi and Manav will be called Bal Mitra. Meanwhile, Montu has come up with a new plan for impressing Monica but Manish and Neil want to stop him in his tracks.

videos.title: Meher And Manav's Magical Powers
videos.overview: Rani Pari hands over the Smriti Yantra to Bal Sakhi and Bal Mitra and instructs them to go and meet with Guru Dev. Baalveer is also going along with them. In school, Neil and Manish have managed to spoil Montu's plans and in doing so, have impressed Monica. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

videos.title: Gurudev's New Plan
videos.overview: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi have gone to meet with Guru Dev and convince him that the Paris have not betrayed him. However, they are stopped by Vaayu, Guru Dev's disciple. Can the three of them somehow manage to defeat him?

videos.title: Hunt For Smriti Yantra
videos.overview: Guru Dev has created the 'Maha Sarvanashi Astra' and he gives it to Vaayu so that he can destroy the Paris. Meanwhile, the Paris are going to Pratham Griha to search for the Smriti Yantra. Will the Paris be able to convince Guru Dev of their innocence? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Rani Pari Finds Smriti Yantra
videos.overview: The Paris have found the Smriti Yantra which will help them prove their innocence to Guru Dev. While at school, Montu tries to tarnish Neil and Manish's reputation in front of Monica. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: King Of Vinash Lok
videos.overview: In the absence of Mahavinashni and Shatir Pari, Tauba-Tauba has proclaimed himself to be the King of Vinash Lok for two days! While in school, there is a surprise in store for all of the kids. What is this surprise? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Mahavinashni In Shakti Lok
videos.overview: Rani Pari gets to know that Mahavinashni has gone to Shakti Lok to get more magical powers. And, if she succeeds in her motives then she will become more powerful than Baalveer. Meanwhile in school, all the kids are excited to see the premiere of the latest film, Angry Birds!

videos.title: Angry Birds Protect Children
videos.overview: The children are eagerly waiting for the movie to begin but Tauba Tauba plans to trap them inside the theatre and terrorize them. But the children have someone else that will protect them from harm. Who is this secret protector? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Powers
videos.overview: Everyone in Pari Lok is rejoicing and eating Laddoos. Manav has a weird dream about a Mummy in a museum. The next day, the kids end up going to the same museum for their school trip. Is this just a coincidence or a sign of bad things to come? Keep watching and find out.

videos.title: Mummy Attacks Manav
videos.overview: The Mummy from the museum has come alive and is searching for its bracelet. It's Manav who has brought the bracelet home with him. The Mummy comes to the school, in search of Manav. Want to know more? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: Hunt For Pharaoh Rajkumar
videos.overview: The Mummy on Earth is searching for the bracelet and the Pharaoh prince. Shatir Pari makes a deal with the Mummy to help him search, in exchange for helping her end Bal Veer and his friends.

videos.title: Mummy Looks For Pharaoh Prince
videos.overview: The Mummy believes that the Pharaoh Prince has been reborn as Manav and is searching for him desperately at the school. Meanwhile, Bal Sakhi and Baalveer are concerned for Manav's safety. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Mummy Hypnotizes Baalsakhi
videos.overview: The Pharaoh warrior has hypnotized Bal Sakhi and has made her his loyal subject. Baalveer has hidden Manav in a safe place but the Pharaoh Warrior finds them with the help of Bal Sakhi. Can Baalveer and Bal Mitra fight with Bal Sakhi? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Duplicate
videos.overview: Shatir Pari feels that her plan to end Baalveer will finally be successful. Meanwhile, the Mummy takes Manav to the Pyramid in hopes of turning him into the Pharaoh Prince once again.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba's Plan
videos.overview: Tauba Tuaba is not in the mood for attacking Earth today and wants to relax. Shatir Pari sees him lazing around and teaches him a good lesson. While on Earth, Neil has gone for a school exchange program but Saloni seems upset about it.

videos.title: Kalpana Gami Yantra
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba overhears Montu and Rohit's discussion about impressing Monica. He decides to use the Kalpana Gami Yantra and sends Montu to the world of imaginations! Meanwhile, Bapu ji is preparing for an acting role.

videos.title: Tauba Tauba's Trap For Baalveer
videos.overview: Montu is living his best life in the imaginary world. Baalveer asks Tauba Tauba about the whereabouts of his friends but doesn't believe in his words. Can Baalveer save Montu and his other friends from the Imaginary World?

videos.title: Montu In Dreamland
videos.overview: Montu is living lavishly with Monica in the imaginary world and all the other kids are giving them a royal treatment. At the same time, Baalveer has also entered the Imaginary world but he puts on a disguise so no one can recognize him. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Montu To Ring The Bell
videos.overview: Baalveer has dressed up as a clown and tries to get Montu to ring the bell that will help in getting him out of the Imaginary world. Meanwhile, Baapu ji is upset as he was not selected for the ad film. Find out more in this episode.

videos.title: Ballu In Montu's Dreamland
videos.overview: Montu rings the bell and all the kids are able to get out of the Imaginary world. A strange earthquake occurs in Pari Lok and Bal Sakhi is left in a trance. What has happened to Bal Sakhi? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Faulty Chetavni Yantra
videos.overview: Rani Pari gets an intuition of an unknown evil on Earth. Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi go to investigate but find nothing. What could be this new threat that has Rani Pari so worried? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Baal Sakhi's Evil Powers
videos.overview: The Chetavani Yantra is now working properly, which means that Paris will now be able to identify the looming threat which they couldn't before. Bal Sakhi gets anxious after hearing this and decides to flee from Pari Lok after a strange aircraft attacks.

videos.title: Virus Plans To Destroy Pari Lok
videos.overview: A woman named 'Error' has disguised herself as Bal Sakhi, while the real one lies unconscious in a ship, somewhere in space. On Earth, Bapuji and Mahesh are finding it difficult to hide Khoonkhaar Don in their home. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Baalveer Rescues Friends
videos.overview: Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi, both have been kidnapped by Error and taken to her master, Virus, in the space ship. However, Baalveer has managed to follow Error back to the spaceship. Can Baalveer save his friends from Virus? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Virus Threatens Rani Pari
videos.overview: Virus has installed an explosive chip in Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi's palm and has activated the timer for the destructive device. The Paris have tried using their magic but nothing seems to work. Is this it for our three heroes? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer's Invisible Enemy
videos.overview: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi go to investigate the blast site. They are surprised to find nothing there. Meanwhile, a news broadcast shows the three heroes attacking a building. Rani Pari gets furious seeing this and warns that if this turns out to be true she will strip the three of them of their powers.

videos.title: New Enemy Of Pari Lok
videos.overview: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi are all desperate to find the true evil behind the attack and to prove to Rani Pari of their innocence. Meanwhile, Prachandika travels to space and sets her evil plan in motion. What is her plan? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Evil Powers' Intention
videos.overview: With Prachandika's power, she takes control of all the electronic equipment on Earth. Her first plan of action would be to crash a plane. Can Baalveer prevent that from happening? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Buri Shakti Challenges Rani Pari
videos.overview: The Paris have activated the Chetavni Yantra in order to locate the evil force that is threatening the Earth. Prachandika has kidnapped a few children from Earth and has put them up in a rocket full of explosives. She has challenged Rani Pari to come and save them. What is going to happen now?

videos.title: Baalveer Rescues Kids
videos.overview: Bal Sakhi and Bal Veer are trying their best to save the kids who are trapped in the spacecraft. At that moment, the spacecraft hits Bal Sakhi and she begins to fall to the ground at an extremely fast pace. Who will Baalveer save first? The children or her friend?

videos.title: Baalveer In Digital Lok
videos.overview: Prachandika can destroy the earth with nuclear bombs, by just pressing a button. But first, she wants to make the Paris suffer. In the meantime, Baalveer has entered the Digital Lok and is going to derail Prachandika's evil plan. Can Baalveer stop her from destroying everything? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Prachandika's New Master Plan
videos.overview: All the Paris are overjoyed, seeing the new Pari Lok shaping up beautifully. However, Prachandika has set up a barrier around it, that will prevent the Paris from entering the new Pari Lok. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Team Baalveer Enters Pari Lok
videos.overview: Baalveer and Bal Sakhi are attempting to enter the new Pari Lok through the fifth door. Meanwhile, Montu is upset that Monica did not choose him for the dance. Chittu gives him a gadget which will apparently help him get the dance with Monica. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Baalveer Vows To Kill Prachandika
videos.overview: Bal Sakhi has been captured by a giant snake, Baalveer and Bal Mitra are trying their best to free her from its clutches. Meanwhile, Montu decides to use Chittu's gadget to impress Monica. Keep watching to find out more.

videos.title: Dhwani Yantra
videos.overview: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi are fighting against a giant monster. In order to win, they need to find the monster's weakness. Meanwhile, Montu has started facing a lot of problems because of Chittu's gadget. Can our heroes get to the fifth door? Find out by right here.

videos.title: Baalveer In Prachand Lok
videos.overview: Baalveer and Bal Sakhi have fallen down the hole of a Volcano. Meanwhile, Prachandika has conjured up a cloud to destroy the whole Pari Lok. Can the three enter Pari Lok in time?

videos.title: Rain Of Mercury
videos.overview: Bal Sakhi and Bal Mitra have turned invisible to fight the evil Prachandika. To even the odds, Prachandika pours down some mercury rain from the sky which freezes the three heroes. Will they be able to defeat her to save Pari Lok? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Prachandika's Trap For Baalveer
videos.overview: Prachandika decides to attack school children to draw the attention of Baalveer and his friends. While in School, Montu tries to gain Monica's sympathy by getting a fake plaster done. What is going to happen now? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Monica Thrashes Montu
videos.overview: Montu tries to play a prank on Manav and Mhere but it backfires. Meanwhile, Prachandika has come to the school disguised as a doctor with a magical injection. What does this injection do? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Evil Powers' Conspiracy
videos.overview: Prachandika is posing to be a doctor who has come for a vaccination camp in school. But in reality, her motives are to transform one of the kids into a powerful monster with the Makadgenea injection. What will happen now?

videos.title: Prachandika's Ploy
videos.overview: Mahesh and Bapu Ji have turned into powerful monsters and are creating havoc on Earth. Dari Pari witnesses all this and informs Rani Pari. Everything seems to be going according to Prachandika's plan. Stay tuned for more.

videos.title: Spark Of The Evil
videos.overview: Prachandika has turned Mahesh and Bapu Ji into evil monsters. To save the Paris, Baalveer will have to attack both of them. However, Manav and Meher won't let him do this. How can Bal Veer overcome this situation? Find out right now.

videos.title: Baalveer In Dilemma
videos.overview: Prachandika wants to make Meher and Manav fight amongst themselves but three heroes seem sure of their friendship. Meanwhile, Rohit and Chittu convince Montu to paint his face black. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer Saves Baal Sakhi
videos.overview: Prachandika has all the Paris tied up at her mercy. Meanwhile, Baalveer is made to fight Bal Sakhi and Bal Mitra or else Prachandika will end all the Paris with a destructive arrow. Can Baalveer save them? Find out now.

videos.title: Baalveer Spoils Prachandika's Plan
videos.overview: Prachandika hears the buzzing of her Chetavni Yantra from the place where the Makadgenea is. She goes to investigate and leaves the Paris under Mahesh and Bapu Ji's supervision. She is shocked to see Baalveer, Bal Sakhi and Bal Mitra standing together united against her. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Electricity Bolt
videos.overview: A scientist has invented a 'Bijli Gola' which is extremely powerful and can drain out all electrical energy from the world. It has gone missing and Baalveer is helping to look for it. Meanwhile, at school, the kids are playing basketball and fighting over who gets to have Monica in their team.

videos.title: Bijli Manav
videos.overview: The Bijli ka Gola is proving to be difficult to deal with for Baalveer and his friends and he has been knocked out by it. Bal Sakhi decides to bury it into the ground so that it can't have any effect on Earth's surface. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: End Of Bijli Manav
videos.overview: The Bijli Manav starts causing a lot of damage on Earth. He targets Montu and the other kids at school but Bal Veer comes in time for their rescue. Can Baalveer stop him from causing more destruction? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Bijli Manav's Threat To Baalveer
videos.overview: Our heroes are continuing their fight against the Bijli Manav but his attacks keep getting stronger. Meanwhile, Saloni is in a critical condition after getting hurt in the Bijli Manav attack. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer Kills Bijli Manav
videos.overview: Baalveer is able to defeat Bijli Manav and Saloni also recovers from her injuries. However, Prachandika has returned more powerful than ever. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Prachandika's New Conspiracy
videos.overview: Prachandika has kidnapped children from Earth and brings them to her kingdom. She goes to an insane asylum to break out Mastishk who is a mad scientist and is gonna use the kids to create a supercomputer. Stay tuned for more.

videos.title: Prachandika's Plan Against Baalveer
videos.overview: Mastishk is successful in building his supercomputer and he names it 'Soch 1000'. But Prachandika is unsure whether the computer can beat Baalveer's mental power. Stay tuned for more.

videos.title: Prachandika's Illusion
videos.overview: Prachandika has trapped Bal Sakhi along with the other kids and Mastishk is uploading her mind into the computer. Rani Pari is trying to locate Bal Sakhi but is unable to exactly find her location. Can they save Bal Sakhi in time?

videos.title: Baal Mitra In Trouble
videos.overview: Now Bal Mitra is also captured by Prachandika and his mind will be uploaded into the computer just like Bal Sakhi's. Now the computer has the processing power of 5000 human brains which can even outthink Baalveer. What is going to happen now? Keep watching to find out.

videos.title: Baalveer Imprisoned
videos.overview: Bal Veer goes to rescue the kids and his friends but gets captured by Prachandika who is going to connect his brain to the computer. Meanwhile, at school, there is a drama competition and all the students are looking for a subject to perform. Can Baalveer get out of this difficult situation?

videos.title: Playful Montu
videos.overview: The subject chosen by Meher for the drama competition is Baalveer and she has started taking auditions for it. Montu wishes to play the role of Bal Veer. Will he get it? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Prachandika Meets Chittu
videos.overview: Tauba Tauba lands up in Prachand Lok and Prachandika gets furious upon seeing him. She sends him to Earth and hands him a pill for Baalveer. Meanwhile, Manav gets selected for the role of Baalveer and Montu is very upset. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Baalveer's Friends Visit To Pari Lok
videos.overview: The kids have asked Baalveer to take them to Pari Lok so that they can understand their characters better. Tauba Tauba has been cast as Dooba Dooba 1 and plans to give Bal Veer the pill during the play. Find out more in this episode.

videos.title: Pari Lok's Tour
videos.overview: Rani Pari introduces the school kids to all the Paris and tells them about Baalveer's previous adventures as a kid. The rehearsals for the play are about to begin and Prachandika is angry to see how she is being depicted.
